name: Gravel lot at the gate at the end of Longmont Dam Road
basis: MP Longmont Reservoir Area 'Getting There': county road ends at a steel gate and parking area, from which climbers hike the road to River Wall, Old Yellar etc. Road check: this is the only mapped lot in the area and it sits 0.02 km from Longmont Dam Road exactly where the mapped road turns access=no (the gate). MP gives no separate parking coordinate; match is by road geometry.
